stem.text: A pendulum bob is held stationary by a horizontal force $H$. The three forces acting on the bob are shown in the diagram.

stem.alt: Pendulum string drawn at 30 degrees to a dashed vertical line, with arrows at the bob labelled T (along the string), W (downward) and H (horizontal); the 30° angle is marked.

stem.text: The tension in the string of the pendulum is $T$. The weight of the pendulum bob is $W$. The string is held at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the vertical.
